problem: State System has reached a working package-layer shape across personal state, SampleCo, PortfolioCo, ResearchCo, and Relationship Substrate, but the model now needs to become operationally trustworthy and open-source-repeatable. A fresh agent or external adopter should know how to add connectors, declare modules, scaffold instances, federate state, expose gaps, and answer real questions without private prompt knowledge.
stakeholders: Braydon, Sam, Caroline, future company agents such as Helena and Ingrid, and future outside users of the State System product. The cost of not solving this is drift: connectors like Spotify or Garmin become one-off private exceptions, company instances cannot be repeated, and agents answer from stale or incomplete evidence without knowing what is missing.
prior_attempts: The package layer, source modules, tool actions, route contracts, scaffolding command, personal state/SampleCo runtime packages, and PortfolioCo/ResearchCo scaffolds have been implemented. What remains weak is the transition from schema-compatible artifacts to a repeatable lifecycle: source module onboarding, federation pack semantics, freshness repair loops, instance readiness promotion, and real-question pressure tests.
constraints: Do not copy private corpora into the product repo or across deployed instances.
Do not encode connector behavior in private prompts when it belongs in schemas, contracts, docs, or package fields.
Company instances must not inherit personal sources such as Spotify, Garmin, or personal relationship records by default.
Relationship Substrate remains source-owned; State System declares and federates it but does not become a second people database.
Prefer explicit gaps, watermarks, and materialization policies over silent fallback behavior.
Keep implementation tasks scoped so multiple agents can work in parallel.
out_of_scope: Building a hosted SaaS control plane.
Migrating every source connector to live production freshness in one pass.
Inventing live PortfolioCo or ResearchCo data that has not been proven.
Moving private raw data into generic examples.
success_criteria: A new source module can be added from a documented contract kit with schema examples and tests.
A new company instance can be scaffolded and advanced from declared to preflighted to package-ready with visible gaps.
Federation between instances is represented by typed packs with source instance refs, route refs, materialization policy, identity/subject boundaries, freshness, and gap behavior.
Sam and Caroline can answer real pressure questions while naming missing sources and respecting relationship-substrate boundaries.
PortfolioCo and ResearchCo move from scaffolded roots to validated first packages with source readiness evidence.
Workgraph has implementation tasks, eval gates, and repair loops for freshness and federation drift.
